authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 sections 20.1 and 20.4.51
scope: BLOCK_CONTROL source frame and selected block-record membership in the locally generated AC1012 collision pair.
checks: The observer checks both physical CRC-validated control frames: type and self handle, empty EED/reactors and counted list, exact body boundary, typed null owner/extension, and hard-owned model 0x1F and paper 0x20 slots. All byte-prefix truncations and wrong-role mutations are refused; unchanged frames pass again.
The adapter's source-bound, duplicate-free control membership check passes on both drawings and rejects a changed block owner before a corrected retry; the three focused CTests pass.

Independent cadkit-dwg 0.5.4 decodes the selected source control with valid CRC, no counted entries and extra entries 0x1F/0x20, with no remaining data or handle bits. Cadkit is specification-directed and labels R13 untested.
The generated-pair packager records the BLOCK_CONTROL frame hash in addition to the existing boundary hashes. No drawing fixture was committed.
limits: Selected generated R13 source framing and membership only. Whole-file closure, AutoCAD normal-open, cloning behavior, native output and general support remain unqualified.
